generations.notes: One entry for the whole KJ generation: the 2021 facelift and the second facelift (market launch Jan 2026) did not change trunk volume, and SEAT announced no changes to the body or wheelbase. The 4059 mm in the official price list is used here. Width with mirrors is 1942 mm (ADAC). loadSpace measurements were not found.
